summary_zh.motivation: 探讨转换性全髋关节置换术的分类归属。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析转换、初次与翻修THA的临床结局。
summary_zh.result: 转换THA更接近翻修手术的复杂性和并发症率。
summary_zh.validation: 回顾性临床数据统计分析。

summary_en.motivation: To determine whether conversion total hip arthroplasty should be classified as primary or revision surgery based on clinical outcomes.
summary_en.method: A retrospective comparison of conversion THA with primary and revision THA using patient data.
summary_en.result: Conversion THA more closely resembles revision surgery in terms of complication rates and surgical complexity.
summary_en.validation: Retrospective clinical data analysis of patient cohorts.

papers.title: Which prosthetic system restores hip biomechanics more effectively? Comparison among three systems
papers.abstract: Background: The aim of this paper was to compare ability to restore hip biomechanics among short-stem prosthesis (SSP; MiniHip® Corin, UK), cementless total hip arthroplasty (CTHA; Corail® De Puy, USA) and resurfacing prosthesis (RP; Durom® Zimmer, USA). Methods: One hundred and twenty-four patients with a mean age of 52 yr (26–65 yr) operated on for osteoarthritis were retrospectively studied. There were three groups: SSP n=36, CTHA n=46, and RP n=42. Center of rotation, lateralization, and leg-length discrepancy were evaluated on radiographs and compared to the contralateral healthy (or Tönnis 0 or 1) hips. Results: The center of rotation was equally accurate for the three implants evaluated, but the SSP controlled leg-length discrepancy better than the other two implants; 1.2 mm (−4.7-7 mm) compared with 2.3 mm (−6-7.4 mm) for the CTHA and -2.1 mm (−15-8) for the RP (P=0.001). The mean offset discrepancy in the CTHA group was only 0.6 mm (−7-7) compared with 4.5 mm (−4-7) in SSP and −3.9 (−15-8) in the RP group (P=0.003). The offset was more accurately controlled with the CTHA than the rest of the implants (1.7 mm instead of 3.5 [SSP] and -3.9 [RP] [P=0.0038]). Leg-length accuracy within ±5 mm was obtained in 94% of the hips for SSP, 87% for CTHA, and 67% for RP (P=0.003). Conclusions: Restoration of the center of rotation was equally precise with the three analyzed systems. Considering the contralateral healthy hip, SSP restored more favorably limb length, and offset was more accurately restored with CTHA.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅比较不同假体系统对髋关节生物力学恢复的影像学指标，未涉及应力遮挡、微动或有限元分析。
llm.why_not_core: No FEA, no stress shielding or micromotion quantification, no contact mechanics, no intact vs implanted comparison.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较三种髋关节假体系统恢复生物力学的能力。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析124例患者术后X线片，测量旋转中心、偏距和腿长差异。
summary_zh.result: 短柄假体在腿长控制上更优，骨水泥型全髋在偏距恢复上更准确。
summary_zh.validation: 临床影像学测量与对侧健康髋关节对比。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the ability of three hip prosthetic systems (short-stem, cementless THA, resurfacing) to restore hip biomechanics.
summary_en.method: Retrospective radiographic analysis of 124 patients measuring center of rotation, offset, and leg-length discrepancy.
summary_en.result: Short-stem prosthesis better controlled leg-length discrepancy, while cementless THA more accurately restored offset.
summary_en.validation: Clinical radiographic measurements compared to contralateral healthy hips.
